name: swagger-api-tester
description: Deterministically test a local REST API from its OpenAPI/Swagger spec, right inside Claude Desktop. Ask Claude to "test POST /api/users" or "test all endpoints" — the engine generates valid requests, sends them, and validates responses against the documented contract.

base_url.title: API base URL
base_url.description: The running API to test, e.g. http://localhost:8080. Set this to skip all config — no project files needed. Leave blank to auto-detect from the project (Spring Boot / Quarkus / Micronaut).

open_api_url.title: OpenAPI URL (optional)
open_api_url.description: Only needed if the spec is not at a standard path. Usually auto-discovered.

project_path.title: Backend project path
project_path.description: Path to the backend project (for config.json, testValues, auth, or code auto-detection). Leave blank to auto-detect from the current working directory.

allow_remote.title: Allow non-loopback targets
allow_remote.description: Permit testing hosts that are not localhost. This is only the ENV half of the safety gate — config.json must ALSO set allowRemoteTargets:true. prod/live/staging hosts are always refused.
